F-ACC.claim: AverageDamage already contains hit probability and crit

F-AREA.claim: PoB publishes both the raw radius and its own metre conversion

F-CD.claim: a cooldown becomes the use rate: Speed is 1/Cooldown

F-COST.claim: ManaPerSecondCost is ManaCost multiplied by Speed

F-DEF.claim: defensive outputs are present and named

F-DOT.claim: damage over time is a rate; duration does not change it

F-DPS.claim: TotalDPS is AverageDamage multiplied by Speed

F-FULL.claim: FullDPS aggregates groups and includes damage over time

F-PROJ.claim: projectile count does not multiply single-target damage

F-TRIG.claim: a meta gem does not change the socketed spell's cadence

F-UNIT.claim: CombinedDPS is damage per use when the skill sets showAverage
